title: Dune Vista on 30A's Dune Allen Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: Sweeping Gulf views, expansive gathering spaces, and a private pool oasis set the tone for an unforgettable stay at Dune Vista. This second-tier, three-story beach retreat in Dune Allen Beach offers five bedrooms, four full baths, and two half baths across 5,600 square feet&mdash
description_expanded: Sweeping Gulf views, expansive gathering spaces, and a private pool oasis set the tone for an unforgettable stay at Dune Vista . This second-tier, three-story beach retreat in Dune Allen Beach offers five bedrooms, four full baths, and two half baths across 5,600 square feet—comfortably accommodating up to 18 guests. From the upper levels, you can enjoy impressive vistas of the shimmering Gulf, where sunlight dances across the water by day, and coastal breezes carry the soothing rhythm of the surf by night. Spacious balconies on multiple levels invite you to start your morning with coffee at sunrise or wind down beneath cotton-candy skies at sunset. Designed with multi-generational gatherings in mind, the layout offers both grand communal areas and private escapes. The top-floor Great Room is a stunning focal point, featuring soaring ceilings, gleaming hardwood floors, and a wall of windows that frame the Gulf beyond. Plush seating surrounds a large flat-screen TV, while the dining area and expansive granite-topped island provide ample space for shared meals and evening conversations. The open kitchen is beautifully appointed with custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a gas range, side-by-side refrigerator, and a convenient under-counter ice maker—an often-mentioned favorite that makes beach days and poolside refreshments effortless. Just steps away, a covered deck extends the living space outdoors, where the views feel especially breathtaking from the third floor. The first floor serves as a fun and functional retreat for younger guests, featuring four built-in twin bunk beds, a full bath, and a separate living area with a queen sleeper sofa and kitchenette. It’s a cozy haven for kids and teens, while still offering easy access to the 28' x 12' lagoon-shaped private pool just outside. Poolside afternoons are a highlight here, with plenty of space for lounging and a gas grill that makes cookouts part of the daily rhythm. On the second floor, beautifully appointed guest bedrooms include one with a king bed and another with a queen, sharing a well-designed full bath. A luxurious Primary Suite on this level features a four-poster king bed and a spa-inspired bath with double vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. The top-floor Primary Suite offers its own private sanctuary with a king bed, tray ceiling, and a lavish bath that includes a soaking tub and steam shower—an indulgent favorite among returning guests. Beach access is just a one-minute stroll away, making it effortless to spend your days along the sugar-white shoreline and emerald waters of the Gulf. Located along Scenic 30A in Dune Allen Beach , Dune Vista places you in the heart of one of South Walton’s most beloved coastal corridors. From fresh seafood and casual beach cafés to local ice cream shops and favorite barbecue spots, dining options are all within easy reach. Nature lovers will appreciate being near Topsail Hill Preserve State Park, where miles of untouched shoreline and towering dunes create a breathtaking backdrop for hiking, biking, and wildlife watching. Beyond 30A, the best of Destin is also within a short drive—offering championship golf, deep-sea fishing, harborfront dining, and vibrant entertainment. Whether you’re exploring charming beach communities, browsing boutiques, or setting out for a sunset cruise, everything that makes this stretch of the Emerald Coast so special is close at hand. With its spacious design, thoughtful amenities, private pool, and unforgettable Gulf views, Dune Vista delivers the perfect balance of comfort, fun, and refined coastal elegance. First Floor : Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Kitchenette, Bedroom with Four Twin Bunks. Second Floor : King Primary Bedroom, King Bedroom, Queen Bedroom. Third Floor : King Primary Bedroom, Living Area, Dining, Kitchen. *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available October - April if needed). Rates reflect a discount for nearby construction.
